cells.gaps: No regulation or decree applying the law, and no rule made under it that others must check identity against the system, dated in the last three years, is held.
cells.note: Africa24 TV (22 November 2026) says the national enrolment that began on 11 November 2026 is framed by the 2024 law, so the law is in force (BFA-007); the 2024 text sets up a unique biometric identifier (BFA-003). No rule made under it is held, so stage 4.
